contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #083: Hilbert transforms along Lipschitz directions.

Finite positive weighted tops, geometrically nested translated angular grids, decreasing deterministic eligibility sets, the literal boundary denominators eq:src-14, and packet stopping levels of hier:stopping-levels. Verify assembly:boundary-loss without certifying upstream analytic inputs.

definitions.k_T: last eligible level of top T; transitions are exactly i<k_T
definitions.translation: one uniform parameter modulo d(0), shared at every level
definitions.a_i: log(M_i(epsilon)/h_T) for i<k_T and zero otherwise

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 083 (Hilbert transforms along Lipschitz directions.; papers: A uniform Hilbert transform estimate for Lipschitz directions; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/083.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

For all finite natural k,r, real sequences a zero at and beyond k satisfy sum_{i<k}(a_i-a_{i+r})=sum_{j<min(r,k)}a_j; finite geometric-layer integration yields sum_{j<k}q^j a_j and its A/(1-q) bound for 0<=a_j<=A and 0<=q<1. The finite nonnegative-increment suffix identity controls monotone packet deficits with no depth loss.

For every finite weighted top system with the literal eligible masses and boundary denominators, and epsilon=4*G^(-1/4)<1/2, E_theta sum_{i<k_T}log(m_{v_{i+1}(T)}/n_{v_i(T)}) <= 2*epsilon*sum_{j<k_T}G^(-j)*log(M_j(epsilon)/h_T) <= 2*epsilon*(1-G^(-k_T))/(1-1/G)*log(n/h_T), including k_T=0, for one common uniform translation.

For finite normed-vector packet groups on a top T, assume every interval of packet lengths has sum norm <=H_T and |q_T|<=1. With the actual stopping map k_s<=k_T and central coefficient kappa_s=exp(-(mu/K)*sum_{i<k_s}r_i), expected weight-removal error is <=2*epsilon*(mu/K)*H_T*sum_{j<k_T}G^(-j)*log(M_j(epsilon)/h_T), uniformly in depth.

claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open Finset

noncomputable section

namespace BoundaryLoss

def partialSum (a : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i ∈ range k, a i

theorem prefix_succ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    partialSum a (k + 1) = partialSum a k + a k := by
  exact sum_range_succ a k

theorem offset_telescope (a : ℕ → ℝ) (k r : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ range k, (a i - a (i + r))) =
      partialSum a r - ∑ j ∈ range r, a (k + j) := by
  have hkr := sum_range_add a k r
  have hrk := sum_range_add a r k
  rw [Nat.add_comm r k] at hrk
  have hs : (∑ i ∈ range k, a (i + r)) = ∑ i ∈ range k, a (r + i) := by
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [Nat.add_comm]
  rw [sum_sub_distrib, hs]
  dsimp [partialSum]
  linarith

theorem prefix_truncate (a : ℕ → ℝ) (k r : ℕ)
    (hz : ∀ i, k ≤ i → a i = 0) :
    partialSum a r = partialSum a (min r k) := by
  by_cases hr : r ≤ k
  · rw [min_eq_left hr]
  · have hkr : k ≤ r := by omega
    rw [min_eq_right hkr]
    exact eventually_constant_sum hz hkr

theorem stopped_telescope (a : ℕ → ℝ) (k r : ℕ)
    (hz : ∀ i, k ≤ i → a i = 0) :
    (∑ i ∈ range k, (a i - a (i + r))) = partialSum a (min r k) := by
  rw [offset_telescope]
  have ht : (∑ j ∈ range r, a (k + j)) = 0 := by
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro j hj
    exact hz (k + j) (by omega)
  rw [ht, sub_zero, prefix_truncate a k r hz]

theorem geometric_layers (q : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ r ∈ range k, (q ^ r - q ^ (r + 1)) * partialSum a (r + 1)) +
        q ^ k * partialSum a k =
      ∑ j ∈ range k, q ^ j * a j := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [partialSum]
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [sum_range_succ, sum_range_succ, prefix_succ]
      nlinarith [ih]

theorem stopped_layers (q : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (hz : ∀ i, k ≤ i → a i = 0) :
    (∑ r ∈ range k, (q ^ r - q ^ (r + 1)) *
        (∑ i ∈ range k, (a i - a (i + (r + 1))))) +
        q ^ k * partialSum a k =
      ∑ j ∈ range k, q ^ j * a j := by
  have hs :
      (∑ r ∈ range k, (q ^ r - q ^ (r + 1)) *
          (∑ i ∈ range k, (a i - a (i + (r + 1))))) =
        ∑ r ∈ range k, (q ^ r - q ^ (r + 1)) * partialSum a (r + 1) := by
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro r hr
    rw [stopped_telescope a k (r + 1) hz,
      min_eq_left (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (mem_range.mp hr))]
  rw [hs, geometric_layers]

theorem geometric_sum_identity (q : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (1 - q) * (∑ i ∈ range k, q ^ i) = 1 - q ^ k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [sum_range_succ, pow_succ]
      nlinarith [ih]

theorem geometric_sum_finite (q : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hq : q < 1) :
    (∑ i ∈ range k, q ^ i) = (1 - q ^ k) / (1 - q) := by
  apply (eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hq))).2
  nlinarith [geometric_sum_identity q k]

theorem geometric_sum_uniform (q : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    (∑ i ∈ range k, q ^ i) ≤ 1 / (1 - q) := by
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hq1)).2
  nlinarith [geometric_sum_identity q k, pow_nonneg hq0 k]

theorem potential_finite (q A : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) (ha : ∀ i < k, a i ≤ A) :
    (∑ i ∈ range k, q ^ i * a i) ≤ A * (1 - q ^ k) / (1 - q) := by
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ range k, q ^ i * a i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ range k, q ^ i * A := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ha i (mem_range.mp hi)) (pow_nonneg hq0 i)
    _ = A * (∑ i ∈ range k, q ^ i) := by rw [← sum_mul]; ring
    _ = A * (1 - q ^ k) / (1 - q) := by rw [geometric_sum_finite q k hq1]; ring

theorem potential_uniform (q A : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (ha : ∀ i < k, a i ≤ A) :
    (∑ i ∈ range k, q ^ i * a i) ≤ A / (1 - q) := by
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ range k, q ^ i * a i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ range k, q ^ i * A := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ha i (mem_range.mp hi)) (pow_nonneg hq0 i)
    _ = A * (∑ i ∈ range k, q ^ i) := by rw [← sum_mul]; ring
    _ ≤ A * (1 / (1 - q)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (geometric_sum_uniform q k hq0 hq1) hA
    _ = A / (1 - q) := by ring

theorem boundary_log_compare {x u v e : ℝ}
    (hu : 0 < u) (hux : u ≤ x) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hev : e ≤ v - u) :
    Real.log ((x + e) / x) ≤ Real.log (v / u) := by
  have hx : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hu hux
  have hvu : 0 ≤ v - u := le_trans he hev
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hev (le_of_lt hu)
  have hprod := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hux) hvu
  have hratio : (x + e) / x ≤ v / u := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hx hu).2
    nlinarith
  exact Real.log_le_log (div_pos (by linarith) hx) hratio

theorem central_log_cancel (n m : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    Real.log (n 0) - Real.log (n k) +
        (∑ i ∈ range k, (Real.log (n (i + 1)) - Real.log (m i))) =
      ∑ i ∈ range k, (Real.log (n i) - Real.log (m i)) := by
  have ht := sum_range_sub (fun i => Real.log (n i)) k
  simp only [sum_sub_distrib] at ht ⊢
  linarith

theorem abel_suffix {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
    (e : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℕ → V) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ l ∈ range n, partialSum e (l + 1) • x l) =
      ∑ j ∈ range n, e j • (∑ l ∈ Ico j n, x l) := by
  symm
  simp_rw [smul_sum]
  simpa only [Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range, partialSum, sum_smul] using
    sum_Ico_Ico_comm 0 n (fun j l => e j • x l)

theorem abel_suffix_bound {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    (e : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℕ → V) (n : ℕ) (H D : ℝ)
    (he : ∀ j < n, 0 ≤ e j) (hH : 0 ≤ H)
    (hs : ∀ j < n, ‖∑ l ∈ Ico j n, x l‖ ≤ H)
    (hD : partialSum e n ≤ D) :
    ‖∑ l ∈ range n, partialSum e (l + 1) • x l‖ ≤ D * H := by
  rw [abel_suffix]
  calc
    ‖∑ j ∈ range n, e j • (∑ l ∈ Ico j n, x l)‖ ≤
        ∑ j ∈ range n, ‖e j • (∑ l ∈ Ico j n, x l)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = ∑ j ∈ range n, e j * ‖∑ l ∈ Ico j n, x l‖ := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (he j (mem_range.mp hj))]
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ range n, e j * H := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro j hj
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hs j (mem_range.mp hj)) (he j (mem_range.mp hj))
    _ = partialSum e n * H := by rw [← sum_mul]; rfl
    _ ≤ D * H := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hD hH

theorem monotone_deficit_bound {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    (delta : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℕ → V) (n : ℕ) (H : ℝ)
    (hd0 : delta 0 = 0) (hmono : ∀ j < n, delta j ≤ delta (j + 1))
    (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hs : ∀ j < n, ‖∑ l ∈ Ico j n, x l‖ ≤ H) :
    ‖∑ l ∈ range n, delta (l + 1) • x l‖ ≤ delta n * H := by
  let e : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => delta (j + 1) - delta j
  have hp (r : ℕ) : partialSum e r = delta r := by
    simpa only [partialSum, e, hd0, sub_zero] using sum_range_sub delta r
  have he : ∀ j < n, 0 ≤ e j := by
    intro j hj
    exact sub_nonneg.mpr (hmono j hj)
  have hb := abel_suffix_bound e x n H (delta n) he hH hs (by rw [hp])
  simpa only [hp] using hb

end BoundaryLoss

claims.natural_statement: For positive eligible path masses, the central root-to-stop coefficient n_0^t n_k^(-t) product_{i<k}(n_{i+1}/m_{i+1})^t equals product_{i<k}(n_i/m_{i+1})^t, including k=0. Thus the literal eq:src-30 is nonincreasing with the packet stopping level despite eligibility losses.

Manuscript input, not established here: on Z_0 every interval of packet lengths on every top T has vector sum norm <= L^{C_top} h_T^8, as in 05-concentration.tex eq:src-11 and the enlargement after eq:src-12.

Manuscript input, not established here: on Z_0 the positive total top weight n=sum_T h_T satisfies n<=N L^{C_n}; 04-popular-forest.tex eq:src-5 defines 0<h_T<=C_3 and 11-assembly.tex assumes log N<=2L.

Literal thm:main: absolute a_* in (0,1/2), C_* exist so every Lipschitz unit field v:R^2->S^1 with Lip(v)<=1 obeys sup_{0<epsilon<a_*}||H^epsilon_{v,a_*}f||_2<=C_*||f||_2 for Schwartz f; consequently its symmetric principal value is L2 bounded. Not certified in this mission.
Unverified upstream implication red:band-implies-main: the uniform restricted band estimate thm:band-restricted implies thm:main.

Unverified upstream implication red:model-suffices: the logarithmic ordinary bound, L^{-20} disparity-improved Lipschitz bound, and scalar reverse-disparity bound for all admissible finite packet forms imply thm:band-restricted.

Unverified ordinary model inputs: the first and third assertions of assembly:all-model-estimates, namely the logarithmic-m bound and scalar reverse-disparity gain, follow from the ordinary tile estimates eq:src-4.
Unverified assembly:improved-model: the finite popular adjoint sum satisfies integral_F ||P|| <= C L^{-20} N |F|; assembly:all-model-estimates transfers it to the improved finite packet form bound.

Unverified assembly:vertices: for every nonempty root v, shift sigma and parameters Re(zeta)=mu e_sigma, ||Im(zeta)||_2<=L^2, ||n_v^{alpha/p-1} A_v(zeta)||_{Lp(Z;H)} <= L^C S^{1/p}, uniformly in depth, shift, and translation.

Unverified assembly:interpolation: the vertex estimates imply the same Lp bound at zeta=(mu/K,...,mu/K), without a loss depending on K, and the central exponent budget gives assembly:central-power-gain.
Unverified upstream hier:path-expansion: at least half the root amount is carried by good terminal paths, with the terminal weight bound used in the proof of assembly:vertices.
Unverified upstream res:path-product, eq:src-22: the top-weighted integral of each good active-path product of beta_J is bounded by the polynomial-in-L and cutoff bound used by assembly:vertices.

Unverified assembly fixed/moving-exception estimates and original-decomposition: concentration, top-count, path-exception, and original L2 bounds control the original P on discarded sets uniformly for each translation, allowing averaged boundary loss and the central power gain to imply assembly:improved-model.
